implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosure is mandatory when a person acquires shares triggering the 5%/10%/15%/25% thresholds or when open-offer obligations arise; the filing confirms acquisition has occurred but transaction terms remain sealed pending full offer document circulation.

headline: HT Media Limited files SEBI Regulation 31(4) substantial acquisition disclosure with NSE
sum: HT Media Limited submitted a disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4), indicating a triggering event in shareholding or acquisition structure; specifics of the acquirer and consideration not disclosed in available public sources.
detail: HT Media Limited, listed on NSE, filed the Regulation 31(4) disclosure on 19 June 2026 as required under SEBI Takeover Regulations. This disclosure is mandatory immediately upon acquisition crossing a 5% shareholding threshold or upon commencement of a mandatory offer. The filing triggers subsequent disclosure and open-offer obligations under the Regulations if the acquirer crossed 25% shareholding. Full details of the acquirer, consideration, and shareholding percentage are typically contained in the full offer document (24(7) disclosure), which may not yet be public.
